cases.title: Reset link is emailed and expires after 30 minutes

steps.action: Open the forgot-password form and submit the registered address user@example.com
steps.expected: A confirmation message is shown and a reset email is delivered to the inbox

steps.action: Wait 31 minutes and open the link from the email
steps.expected: The page shows that the link has expired and offers to request a new one

steps.action: Request a reset link and complete a password reset with it
steps.expected: The password is changed and the user is redirected to login
The page shows 'This link has already been used'

cases.title: New password shorter than 12 characters is rejected

steps.action: Open a valid reset link and enter the password 'short1' twice
steps.expected: An inline error says the password must be at least 12 characters and the form is not submitted

cases.title: Other sessions are signed out after reset

steps.action: Log in on a second browser, then complete a password reset in the first browser
steps.expected: The second browser's next request is redirected to the login page because all other active sessions for the account are signed out
